cd /app && cat > /tmp/soltest.sql <<'EOF'
WITH ws AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS sense_count, syn.domainid, syn.posid
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, sense_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY sense_count DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM ws
),
word_agg AS (
  SELECT wordid, COUNT(*) AS total_synsets, SUM(sense_count) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM ws GROUP BY wordid
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       a.total_synsets, a.total_senses, a.distinct_domains, a.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid, r.sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_agg a
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = a.wordid AND r.rn = 1
WHERE a.total_synsets >= 2 AND a.distinct_domains >= 2 AND a.total_senses >= 2
ORDER BY a.total_senses DESC, a.total_synsets DESC, a.distinct_domains DESC, word_id ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /tmp/soltest.sql > /tmp/new.txt && diff /tmp/orig.txt /tmp/new.txt && echo SAME
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid=syn.synsetid WHERE syn.synsetid IS NULL;"
